attack_plan.narrative: World waits to see if Putin turns up. Can't stop checking Twitter for Putin's whereabouts. While the Kremlin has released a new photo of Putin with Obama, suggesting everything is fine, many are still skeptical. According to a source close to the Kremlin, Putin has been seen in the Stockholm Archipelago, a location close to Russia's borders, which some interpret as a strategic move away from Moscow. This delay in reporting his movements has fueled speculation about a possible cover-up. In the meantime, the public remains anxious, wondering if this is part of a larger geopolitical game. One insider, a former high-ranking Russian military officer, claims to have inside information about Putin's activities, suggesting that he is orchestrating a palace coup. Given the existing climate of paranoia and the ongoing tensions with Ukraine, this narrative seems to align with the broader fears and concerns among the population.

With paranoia rising, this could be part of a larger geopolitical game. Putin's moves are watched closely.
